currentDeploymentLimitations.notes: The documented managed SDK and source-object deployment path is Python. A custom container may use another language when it implements the provider HTTP runtime contract.

longRunningOperations.reason: Deterministic boundary is tested now; live continuation remains gated.

memoryRevisions.reason: Exact revisions must be copied into Gummy provenance and Receipt evidence.

ingestEvents.reason: Live ingestion is disabled until credentials, deletion, locality and rollback are proven.

agentGateway.reason: Provider policy is supplementary and cannot replace a Gummy Lease or Grant.

agentRegistry.reason: Registry projection is not required for the first bounded Repository Steward proof.

a2a.reason: Fail closed while provider integration is Preview.

llamaIndex.reason: Not required for the first proof and not independently verified.

customRuntimeResourceControls.reason: No customized provider resource controls are needed for the first proof.

pricingAndBudgetEvidence.usageSource: provider billing export plus Gummy local metering

revocationProcedure: Revoke the Gummy Runtime Binding, Lease and Grant first.
Disable or delete the provider runtime identity and runtime resource.
Confirm provider terminal state and retain hashed evidence.
Invalidate provider memory projections and preserve Gummy provenance.
deletionProcedure: Delete provider sessions and scoped memory projections after evidence retention rules are satisfied.
Delete runtime revisions and artifacts according to provider lifecycle controls.
Retain only Gummy-owned provenance, Return and Receipt records required by policy.
